name: speclite
description: Lightweight spec-driven development for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (CLI + VS Code), Cursor, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. Roadmap + per-item plans + git-branch-per-item workflow. Skills for init, plan, build, review, ship, plus optional loop modes (run dispatcher + Stop hook).

interface.shortDescription: Roadmap-driven spec workflow: plan, build, review, ship
interface.longDescription: Lightweight spec-driven development. One roadmap item = one plan = one git branch. Skills for init, plan, build, review, and ship, plus optional loop modes that chain them and halt at deliberate gates.
